# Implement a Nabla task

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/contributing/agents.md`. Confirm the task's observable
acceptance criteria, search for overlapping work, and reuse relevant skills.
Keep the change within the target models and NVIDIA CUDA scope. Run the
cheapest meaningful checks, then any required runtime validation.
Report changed behavior, exact commands, results and unavailable coverage.
Prepare a draft PR for human review when requested; do not merge or approve it.
